summary: Steri Professional Workwear Pvt Ltd offers validated cleanroom and industrial garment rental solutions, focusing on sectors such as pharmaceuticals and electronics. Their products include RFID-enabled, traceable cleanroom garments designed to meet global contamination control standards.

regional_presence.India: The company aims to be a trusted partner in cleanroom and industrial workwear services both in India and globally.
